correctness.rationale: Any Lie endomorphism H=V⊕F_q z has f(v+az)=Av+(ℓ(v)+ca)z, with ω(Av,Aw)=cω(v,w); idempotency implies A²=A,c²=c,ℓA+cℓ=ℓ. c=1 forces symplectic invertible A=id and ℓ=0 (identity); c=0 yields an isotropic image U=imA, dim r≤m, with a projection A and ℓ factoring through U. The number of isotropic r-spaces is Π_{i<r}(q^(2m−i)−q^i)/(q^r−q^i), each with q^{r(2m−r)} projection complements and q^r compatible ℓ, giving rank count a_{m,r}(q)=q^{r(2m−r+1)} times this product. Exponents E_m(r)=(8mr−5r²+3r)/2 have differences 4m−5r+4; maximizer floor((4m+4)/5), with consecutive tie iff m≡4 mod5. Leading constants both 1 give half-half large-q law in tie. Independently computed m=2,q=2 counts ranks 0,1,2,5 =1,240,960,1, sum 1202. Symplectic alternating form and proof valid characteristic two.
